summary: This Form 8-K from West Enclave Merger Corp., a blank-check company, reports the consummation of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, grossing $100 million, plus a concurrent private placement of 425,000 units for $4.25 million. Net proceeds of $101 million were placed in a trust account for public shareholders. The underwriters exercised their overallotment in full, adding 1.5 million units for $15 million, with an additional private placement of $412,500. Separable trading of shares and rights begins May 13, 2026. This is a routine IPO closing and registration event, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
